description: File control is a component with which a user can select a local file. It shows the value of the selected file.
title: Default

description: Use the label attribute to give the file selector an accessible label. For labels that contain HTML, use the label slot instead.
title: Label

description: Add descriptive help text to a switch with the help-text attribute. For help texts that contain HTML, use the help-text slot instead.The help-text attribute should not be used to display error messages. To handle validation and error messaging, use syn-validate for proper error management.
title: Help Text

description: Use the multiple attribute to allow the selection of multiple files.Figma only: Override the button/droparea and value text directly, to indicate that multiple files are selected (“file” -> “files”)
title: Multiple

description: There might be situations, where you don’t want to show the selected value (e. g. when something is automatically uploading).
title: Hide Value

description: The focus event gives the user feedback that the Dropzone has been focused by the keyboard interaction and that the syn-file component is ready for use.
title: Focus

description: Use disabled only when file selection is unavailable, and explain when users can upload files. Use readonly to show previously selected file names without allowing replacement.
title: Disabled

description: Use readonly when users should see previously selected file names but cannot replace them here. Use disabled only when file selection is unavailable.
title: Readonly

description: Use the size attribute to change the component's size.
title: Sizes

description: The invalid status is used to warn the user that the syn-file is invalid. For example, if the entry of text is mandatory and nothing has been entered or if a text has been entered that does not have the correct format.
title: Invalid

description: Use the droparea attribute to switch to a full-width button with a drop area.
title: Droparea

description: The webkitdirectory setting allows users to select entire directories instead of individual files. When a directory is chosen, all files inside (including those in sub-directories) are selected. Although this feature is not part of the official HTML specification, it is widely supported across major browsers.
title: Directory
